_meta.note: Field labels, plain-language help and preset templates for the automation configuration (task book 4.3 / 4.4 / 4.6). Help text avoids jargon; only where precision is required does it mention the developer-tools route.

help.step3_title: Step 3: what the AI should do
help.paste_selector: Right-click the task link → Inspect → right-click the highlighted code → Copy → Copy selector → paste it here.

task_list_url.label: Task list URL
task_list_url.help: The page address that shows all your tasks. Copy it from the browser address bar and paste it here.

task_list_selector.label: Task link position
task_list_selector.help: Where the task links you want the program to click are on the page. Click the 🎯 Pick on page button on the right, then click a task name in the page. If you must type it manually: right-click the task link → Inspect → right-click the highlighted code → Copy → Copy selector → paste it here.

task_row_selector.label: Task row container (optional)
task_row_selector.help: If one task occupies a whole row on the page (for example a table row), put that row's position here so the program can locate it more accurately. Leave it empty if you are not sure.

next_page_selector.label: Next page button (optional)
next_page_selector.help: If the task list has several pages, put the position of the Next page button here and the program will turn pages by itself. Leave it empty when there is only one page.

task_detail_file_selector.label: Attachment position on the detail page
task_detail_file_selector.help: After you open a task you can see the download links for its attachments. Click 🎯 Pick on page and choose “attachment on the detail page”: the program first opens the first task automatically, then you click the attachment name.

file_extensions.label: File types to process
file_extensions.help: Tells the program which file types to handle. Typical: pdf, docx for contracts; xlsx for spreadsheets. Tick the boxes or type the list.

instruction.label: Task instruction
instruction.help: Tells the AI what to do with the files. Write in plain words what to extract and what kind of opinion to produce.
instruction.example: Extract the contract amount, payment method and terms, penalty ratio, both parties and the signing date; flag anything out of policy

task_name.label: Result folder name (optional)
task_name.help: The name used for the result folder. It defaults to the task name and usually needs no change.

results_root_name.label: Result root folder name
results_root_name.help: The folder that holds the batch results. It is called results by default and sits in the program folder.

results_location.label: Where to save results (optional)
results_location.help: Fill this in if you want results on another drive or on a shared folder. Leave it empty to use the program folder.

max_tasks.label: Maximum tasks per run
max_tasks.help: How many tasks one run should handle at most, so a single run cannot get out of hand.

page_timeout_ms.label: Page timeout (milliseconds)
page_timeout_ms.help: How long to wait for a page to open at most. Increase it if your intranet system is slow.

retries.label: Retries on failure
retries.help: How many times a failed task is retried automatically.

dedupe.label: Skip tasks already processed
dedupe.help: When ticked, tasks you already processed are skipped next time so no work is repeated.

manual_login_wait_seconds.label: Wait for manual verification (seconds)
manual_login_wait_seconds.help: When a CAPTCHA appears or a login is needed the program pauses and waits for you, at most this long.

llm_temperature.label: Generation temperature
llm_temperature.help: Higher makes answers more varied, lower makes them more conservative. Around 0.3 suits review work.

llm_max_tokens.label: Maximum length per opinion (tokens)
llm_max_tokens.help: How long each review opinion may be. Longer output is slower.

download_dir.label: Temporary download folder (optional)
download_dir.help: Attachments are downloaded here first and deleted after processing. Leave empty to use the system temp folder.

audit_log_file.label: Audit log file
audit_log_file.help: One record is appended to this file per task so the run can be traced afterwards.

browser_channel.label: Browser to use
browser_channel.help: Which browser the automation opens pages with. Microsoft Edge installed on the machine is the default.

save_results.label: Save result files
save_results.help: Clear this to do a dry run only — no result file is written.

wait_network_idle.label: Wait for the page to finish loading
wait_network_idle.help: When ticked the program waits until network requests stop before acting: steadier, a little slower.

schedule_enabled.label: Run on a schedule
schedule_enabled.help: Turn this on to run automatically at fixed times every day.

schedule_times.label: Scheduled times
schedule_times.help: The times of day to run automatically; separate several times with commas.

start_with_windows.label: Start with Windows
start_with_windows.help: Launch EchoDesk automatically after signing in to Windows.

enabled.label: Automation master switch
enabled.help: Can only be switched on after you accept the safety protocol below.

safety_accepted.label: I have read and accept the safety protocol
safety_accepted.help: Automation acts as you on web pages, reads attachments and hands their content to the local model. Please confirm you are authorised to do this.

contract.label: Contract financial review
contract.instruction: Extract the contract amount, payment method and terms, penalty ratio, both parties and the signing date; flag anything out of policy

invoice.label: Invoice data extraction
invoice.instruction: Extract the invoice number, issue date, amount, tax, buyer, seller and line items

report.label: Report key points
report.instruction: Summarize the core conclusions, key figures and recommended actions

table.label: Spreadsheet cross-check
table.instruction: Check whether amounts add up to the totals and flag abnormal rows

automation.import_lang_notice: Note: this configuration was authored with the interface language "{source}" while you are using "{current}". Values are imported as-is, so please check whether the selectors and instructions need adjusting.
automation.import_safety_reset: For safety the imported file does not carry over the safety protocol or the automation master switch; accept them on this machine before running.
